unharnessed.meaning: Every point kept, links and examples intact: the branch-name examples, revert-or-push fix, one change per commit, the rename/tests example, backup to remote storage.
unharnessed.sense: Exact: "knock over every step" for complete, "what's cooking" for ongoing work, "without stuffing up the default branch", "bin the variable rename", "run their eye over".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural Aussie workplace voice: "For the lowdown", "chip in on", "If you cock something up", "fix the stuff-up", "busting your arse".
unharnessed.register: Well retold and casual, a little lighter than a full level-5 yarn in places ("Commit and push your changes to your branch."); swearing "cock something up", "busting your arse" within level 2.
unharnessed.tone: Still a practical how-to, with the casual voice on top.
unharnessed.flow: Reads smoothly: "Your branch is a safe spot to muck around with changes."
unharnessed.variety: Varied: "no-fuss", "have a go", "hook up", "muck around", "smear the rename", "throw in".
unharnessed.essence: Unmistakably the GitHub flow docs, structure and links intact.

yarn.meaning: Complete and accurate; the one addition, the "asdf" commit-message jibe ending "ya mug.", hangs off the commit-message advice.
yarn.sense: Fits: "fix the blue" for mistake, "your own little paddock", "offsiders", "Down the track", "done and dusted".
yarn.authenticity: Mostly a real Aussie voice ("every man and his dog", "a bloody sight harder"), with a couple of non-local stock lines ("Whatever floats ya boat.", "Okay, so.").
yarn.register: A full level-5 yarn across every section; swearing "bloody" within level 2.
yarn.tone: Still a friendly how-to, but "ya mug" to the reader edges into ribbing the docs never do.
yarn.flow: Lively but the "ya" tic gets thick ("Ya can do every step of GitHub flow", "the tools ya can hook up to GitHub with").
yarn.variety: Wide range: "have a quick squiz", "what's on the go", "have a crack", "ditch the rename", "Chuck the rename".

engine.meaning: Facts mostly survive, but insults are added throughout ("ya drongo", "ya flamin' mongrel", "ya old bastard") and link titles are altered ("Creating brand-spankin'-new files", "Moving a file to a brand-spankin'-new location").
engine.sense: "see ongoing work at a squiz", "brand-spankin'-new files" for new files: terms forced into slots that do not fit.
engine.authenticity: Stage-Australian bolt-ons: "Stone the crows", "Fair fuckin' dinkum", "Bloody hell, this means that you can access yer bloody work", "Stone the flamin' crows."
engine.register: Exclamations and insults sprinkled on untranslated docs ("Give each commit a descriptive message to help ya and future contributors understand"); swearing within level 2 but no real retelling.
engine.tone: A helpful guide made abusive: "make suggestions or contributions, ya old bastard."
engine.flow: Broken joins: "Listen, Additionally", "Anyway, Ideally", "By committin''n pushin'".
engine.essence: The docs are there underneath, but no longer read as documentation.
